_weights._note: w_religious_rigidity 0.8 and w_magic_fear 0.7: this is the environment that produced heresy trials and, later, witch trials. Far more dangerous for a natural philosopher than Trajanic Rome, which had no doctrine to offend. Guilds resist labour-saving machinery violently and have legal standing to do it.
_weights._note_eminence: A king who can attaint you, but also chartered towns, guilds and a church with its own courts, so power is more divided than in Rome.
